base64-encoder-decoder.html.desc_meta: Encode or decode Base64 data instantly. Support for text and files. 100% private, browser-side conversion. Free online Base64 tool.
base64-encoder-decoder.html.sub: Quickly transform text or binary data into Base64 format and back with local browser logic.
base64-encoder-decoder.html.intro_p: Base64 is a binary-to-text encoding scheme used to represent data in an ASCII string format. It's essential for embedding images in HTML, sending attachments in email, or transmitting binary data over text-based protocols. Our tool makes this translation instant and secure by keeping your data entirely in your browser.
steps: Choose the 'Encode' or 'Decode' mode from the toggle.
Paste your text or upload a file—the result appears instantly in the output pane.
Use the 'Copy' button to grab your Base64 string or download the decoded file.
faq: Does Base64 encrypt data?
No. Base64 is an encoding format, not an encryption method. It can be easily decoded by anyone.
Is the conversion private?
Yes. We use JavaScript's btoa() and atob() methods locally. Your data is never sent to our servers.
Can I encode images?
Yes, you can upload small files to convert them into 'Data URLs' for use in web development.
Is there a limit on input size?
It's limited by your browser's memory, typically allowing several megabytes of data to be processed instantly.

jwt-decoder.html.desc_meta: Decode JWT (JSON Web Tokens) and inspect the header, payload, and signature. Check token expiry and data. Free online JWT decoder — 100% private.
jwt-decoder.html.sub: Inspect your JWT tokens with color-coded breakdowns and human-readable timestamps.
jwt-decoder.html.intro_p: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) are a standard for securely transmitting information between parties as a JSON object. Our decoder allows you to peek inside the 'encoded' string to see the claims, expiration date, and algorithm used—all without ever exposing your token to a server.
steps: Paste your encoded JWT into the input field.
The tool instantly splits the token into its three parts: Header, Payload, and Signature.
Review the decoded JSON for each section and check the 'Token Status' badge for expiration info.
faq: Does this tool verify the signature?
This tool is a client-side decoder. It shows you the content but does not verify the signature against a secret key since that would require your private key.
Is my token secure?
Yes. We do not store or transmit your token. The decoding happens entirely inside your browser tab.
What do the colors mean?
The Header is red, the Payload is purple, and the Signature is blue, following the standard JWT formatting.
Can I see the expiration time?
Yes, we automatically convert the 'exp' unix timestamp into a human-readable local date and time.

url-encoder-decoder.html.benefit: Safe URL Encoding for Web Links
url-encoder-decoder.html.desc_meta: Encode or decode URLs and parameters for safe web transmission. Handle special characters effortlessly. Free, private online URL tool.
url-encoder-decoder.html.sub: Ensure your web links are correctly formatted by encoding special characters and reserved symbols.
url-encoder-decoder.html.intro_p: URL encoding (percent-encoding) is used to translate special characters into a format that can be safely transmitted over the internet as part of a URL. Our tool handles everything from simple query parameters to complex nested URLs, ensuring your links never break due to spaces or symbols.
steps: Paste the URL or text component you need to transform into the editor.
Click 'Encode' to make it URL-safe, or 'Decode' to turn %20 back into spaces.
Copy the result instantly for use in your code or browser address bar.
faq: Why do I need to encode URLs?
URLs can only contain a specific set of characters. Symbols like &, ?, and spaces have special meanings and must be encoded to avoid errors.
Is this tool safe for sensitive links?
Yes. We use browser-native decodeURIComponent and encodeURIComponent. No data is sent to any server.
What is a 'Full URL' vs 'Component'?
Full URL encoding preserves separators like : and / while Component encoding transforms everything, which is useful when nesting URLs as parameters.
Does it support UTF-8?
Yes, it fully supports Indian languages, emojis, and all standard UTF-8 characters.

uuid-generator.html.desc_meta: Generate strong, unique UUIDs (Universally Unique Identifiers) in bulk. Support for v4 (random) and v1 (time-based). Free online UUID generator.
uuid-generator.html.sub: Instantly create unique identifiers for databases, testing, or development projects.
uuid-generator.html.intro_p: A Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) is a 128-bit number used to uniquely identify information in computer systems. Because they are practically guaranteed to be unique, they are perfect for primary keys in databases or session IDs in web apps. Our generator creates these locally with zero server overhead.
steps: Select the version (v4 for random, v1 for time-based).
Specify how many UUIDs you want to generate at once (up to 100).
Click 'Generate' and copy the list to your clipboard with a single click.
faq: What is the difference between v1 and v4?
v4 is entirely random and is the most common for web apps. v1 includes the current time and MAC address (anonymized in browser).
Are these UUIDs unique?
Yes. The probability of a collision (two matches) is so low that it is effectively impossible in any real-world application.
Do you store the generated IDs?
No. They are generated and displayed only in your current session. Once you refresh, they are gone.
Can I generate them in bulk?
Yes, you can generate up to 100 UUIDs per click with our optimized local engine.

random-number-generator.html.desc_meta: Generate truly random numbers within any range. Bulk generate unique integer lists. Free online random number generator — 100% private.
random-number-generator.html.sub: Quickly create random data for statistics, games, or decision-making.
random-number-generator.html.intro_p: Our Random Number Generator uses the cryptographically secure `crypto.getRandomValues()` API in your browser. This ensures that the numbers generated are not just 'pseudo-random' but meet modern standards for fairness and unpredictability, all without any server interaction.
steps: Define your 'Minimum' and 'Maximum' range (e.g., 1 to 100).
Set the 'Quantity' of numbers you need.
Check 'Allow Duplicates' or 'Unique Only' depending on your requirements and click 'Roll'.
faq: Is the randomness fair?
Yes. We use browser-native crypto APIs which provide high-entropy randomness compared to standard math functions.
Can I generate large lists?
Yes, you can generate hundreds of numbers at once. The output is formatted as a clean, copyable list.
Is it private?
100%. All generation happens in your browser and is never logged or tracked.
Can I use it for a lottery?
While the math is secure, this tool is for general utility. Use specialized hardware-verified systems for large-scale regulated lotteries.

lorem-ipsum-generator.html.desc_meta: Generate custom Lorem Ipsum placeholder text for your designs. Choose words, sentences, or paragraphs. Free online dummy text generator.
lorem-ipsum-generator.html.sub: Create high-quality placeholder text for web layouts, mockups, and presentations.
lorem-ipsum-generator.html.intro_p: Lorem Ipsum is standard dummy text used in the design industry to simulate readable content before final copy is ready. It helps you focus on the layout and typography without being distracted by meaningful words. Our tool allows you to customize the 'meat' of the text to fit any container perfectly.
steps: Select your measurement: Words, Sentences, or Paragraphs.
Enter the count you need (e.g., 5 paragraphs).
Click 'Generate' and then 'Copy' to paste the text directly into your design software.
faq: Where does the text come from?
The text is derived from Cicero's 'De Finibus Bonorum et Malorum', a classic work on ethics from 45 BC.
Can I start with 'Lorem ipsum'?
Yes, there is a checkbox to ensure the text starts with the traditional opening phrase.
Is it free for commercial use?
Absolutely. You can use generated text for any project, commercial or personal.
Can I generate HTML tags?

Currently, it provides raw text. You can wrap it in

tags easily once pasted into your project.

markdown-to-html.html.desc_meta: Convert Markdown to clean HTML instantly. Live side-by-side preview with custom CSS support. Free online Markdown tool — 100% private.
markdown-to-html.html.sub: Write in Markdown and export perfectly formatted HTML for your blog or website.
markdown-to-html.html.intro_p: Markdown is the most popular way to write for the web because it is easy to read and write. Our tool takes your raw .md text and renders it into professional-grade HTML. It's the perfect way to draft blog posts or technical documentation directly in the browser.
steps: Type or paste your Markdown code into the left editor pane.
Watch the 'Preview' panel on the right update instantly with colors and headings.
Copy the raw HTML code or download the file once you're finished.
faq: Which Markdown flavor is used?
We use a standard GFM-compliant (GitHub Flavored Markdown) parser for maximum compatibility.
Can I use images?
Yes, use standard Markdown image syntax. Since it's local, images will render if the URL is accessible from your browser.
Is my documentation safe?
Yes. All rendering happens in your browser memory. We never save or publish your drafts.
Can I copy just the code?
Yes, there is a 'Copy HTML' button that copies the clean source code directly to your clipboard.

regex-tester.html.desc_meta: Test and debug your Regular Expressions (Regex) in real-time. Highlights matches and groups. Free online Regex tool — 100% private.
regex-tester.html.sub: Master complex string pattern matching with instant feedback and group highlighting.
regex-tester.html.intro_p: Regular Expressions (Regex) are sequences of characters used to find and manipulate patterns in text. They are notoriously hard to debug, so our tester provides visual highlights for every match and capture group as you type, making it easy to see exactly what your pattern is hitting.
steps: Enter your Regex pattern in the top field (e.g., [a-z0-9]+).
Paste your test data into the main editor area.
Toggle flags like Global (g) or Case-Insensitive (i) to see how the matches change instantly.
faq: Which Regex engine is used?
We use the browser's native JavaScript RegExp engine, which is standard across most web development environments.
Does it support capture groups?
Yes! Your capture groups will be highlighted and listed in a detailed breakdown table.
Is my data sent to a server?
No. Everything happens in your browser memory. Your sensitive logs or data are strictly private.
How do I fix an error?
If your regex is invalid, the editor will highlight the character causing the syntax error.

css-gradient-generator.html.desc_meta: Create stunning CSS gradients with a visual builder. Linear, radial, and conic support. Copy clean CSS code. Free online gradient generator.
css-gradient-generator.html.sub: Design smooth, multi-color gradients for your buttons, cards, and backgrounds.
css-gradient-generator.html.intro_p: Gradients bring life to modern web design. Our generator gives you a visual canvas to drag color stops, adjust angles, and mix multiple colors until you reach the perfect aesthetic. It generates clean, optimized CSS code that works across all modern browsers.

Add color stops by clicking the bar, and click a stop to change its color using the picker.

faq: Does it support browser prefixes?
Modern browsers use standard syntax, but our tool ensures the output is compatible with all current versions of Chrome, Safari, and Firefox.
Can I add transparent colors?
Yes, you can adjust the Alpha (opacity) of any color stop to create partially transparent gradients.
Is it free?
Yes, completely free with no limits on how many gradients you can create.
Are there presets?
Yes, check the gallery below the generator for popular, designer-curated gradient combinations.

css-minifier.html.benefit: Minimize CSS Code for Fast Loading
css-minifier.html.desc_meta: Minify your CSS code to reduce file size and improve website speed. Strip comments and whitespace instantly. Free online CSS minifier.
css-minifier.html.sub: Optimize your stylesheets for production by removing all unnecessary characters.
css-minifier.html.intro_p: Large CSS files slow down your website. Minification strips away comments, whitespace, and newlines that are helpful for humans but unnecessary for browsers. This tool helps you achieve faster page loads and better SEO scores by serving the smallest possible CSS payload.
steps: Paste your beautiful, indented CSS into the input box.
Click 'Minify'—the tool instantly crushes the code into a single line.
Review the 'Savings %' and download your new .min.css file.
faq: Does it break my code?
No. Our minifier only removes whitespace and comments. The actual CSS rules and logic remain untouched.
Can I un-minify it later?
Minification is a one-way process for size reduction. Always keep your original source file for future development.
How much size will I save?
Typically, you can save 20-40% of your CSS file size depending on how many comments you use.
Is my code safe?
Yes. All minification logic runs in your browser. Your CSS is never sent to any server.
